journey: A reader opens three.ws/materialize, drops in a .glb (or picks a model from the Forge), sees whether it will print, and gets an exact itemized price in USDC on Solana. The trial runs that path against production: a real .glb is uploaded and priced, a real Forge creation is priced, and a model that cannot print is refused with the reason. It does NOT place or pay for an order, and nothing here can show that anyone prints or ships an object: three.ws does not print or ship physical orders.

steps.name: a dropped .glb is uploaded, checked as printable, and gets a signed, itemized USDC-on-Solana price
a model made in the Forge is picked by its creation id and gets an exact price
a Forge model whose walls are too thin to print is refused, with the measured reason
the live /materialize page checks a Forge creation and shows its USDC price
